statements.t: We have established long-term relationships as a critical solutions provider to many of the leading companies with asset-intensive infrastructure in our target markets.
We believe long-term growth can be realized in our target markets.
Our level of business and financial results are impacted by world-wide macro- and micro-economic conditions generally, as well as those within our target markets.

Among other things, we expect the timing of our oil and gas customers' inspection spending to be impacted by fluctuations in oil prices and broader market conditions, including potential geopolitical disruptions and uncertainty arising from conflicts in the Middle East.

On September 17, 2026, the Company entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “Merger Agreement”) with Athena Purchaser, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (“Parent”), and Athena Merger Sub, Inc., a Delaware corporation and a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent (“Acquisition Sub”), pursuant to which, subject to the terms and conditions of the Merger Agreement, Acquisition Sub will be merged with and…

The Merger is expected to close in late 2026 or early 2027, subject to, among other things, approval of the Merger by the Company’s stockholders, expiration or termination of the applicable waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976, as amended (the “HSR Act”), the receipt of certain required regulatory approvals, and the satisfaction or waiver of certain other customary closing…
If the Merger is completed, the Company’s common stock will be delisted from the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) and deregistered under the Exchange Act.

The Company believes that it is probable that the Company will be able to comply with the financial covenants in the Credit Agreement and that sufficient credit remains available under the Credit Agreement to meet the Company's liquidity needs.

risks.t: the following: (i) the ability to complete the Merger on the anticipated timeline, or at all
(v) the Company may be adversely affected by other economic, business, legislative, regulatory and/or competitive factors
(vii) the occurrence of any event, change or other circumstance that could give rise to the termination of the Merger Agreement
(viii) potential disruption to the business of the Company as a result of the announcement and pendency of the Merger
(ix) the diversion of management attention from the Company’s ongoing business operations as a result of the Merger
(x) adverse effects on the Company’s ability to retain and hire key personnel as a result of the announcement or pendency of the Merger
(xi) volatility in the Company’s stock price prior to the completion of the Merger
(xv) the creditworthiness of our customers and our ability to collect our accounts receivable
(xvi) changes in interest rates and foreign currency exchange rates

estimates.t: There have been no significant changes to our critical accounting policies and estimates from the information provided in Item 7, “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,” included in the 2025 Annual Report.
